Trouble Shooter: Yes, it's ridiculously easy. Yes, it only takes about fifteen to twenty minutes to beat. But fuck that noise! I love the shit out of this game. What's not to love about cute chicks on jetpacks shooting the shit out of some cartoony villain's robot henchmen?

E-SWAT: In a genre filled with super-powered suits, this game stands out as an early attempt at portraying a power armor realistically. Your weapons don't define You, they are things any grunt could carry. You've got a jetpack, but it's limited and meant more for quick maneuvers than just flying around. Greendog The beached surfer dude: Unique, fun, not too hard. A cool little-known title.
